title: Link modernization challenges to planning themes
challenge_summary: Common modernization gaps create change risk.
planning_thesis: Pair each challenge with a clear planning response.
response_1_heading_and_detail: Clarify accountable roles and escalation paths.
challenge_1: Decision rights are unclear across product, platform, and operations.
response_2_heading_and_detail: Trace service calls and shared data flows.
challenge_2: Teams cannot easily trace critical service dependencies.
response_3_heading_and_detail: Review support status, security, and recovery needs.
challenge_3: Unsupported technology can increase support and recovery risk.
response_4_heading_and_detail: Define test boundaries and cutover constraints.
challenge_4: Release coordination is constrained by shared interfaces.
response_5_heading_and_detail: Agree baselines and accountable data owners.
challenge_5: Value measures lack consistent definitions and owners.
